name: Roland's Doom
summary: Nightbane worgen hold Roland's Doom, east of the Rotting Orchard in southeastern Duskwood. The mine is abandoned, and its tunnels are a dangerous den.

sections.title: A Den of Shadows and Savagery
sections.body: Roland's Doom lies in the ridges east of the Rotting Orchard, where the mine has long stood idle. Nightbane worgen now use its tunnels as a staging ground, under leaders such as Gutspill and Nefaru. Snarls carry through the dark shafts, and the damp earth is stained with blood. Travelers who enter face one of Duskwood's most perilous places.

sections.title: The Fall of Velinde Starsong
sections.body: Deep in Roland's Doom, the night elven priestess Velinde Starsong met her end while carrying the Scythe of Elune, an ancient artifact of immense and volatile power. Disturbed earth in the mine can stir Velinde's lingering spirit, who speaks of her final moments. Later, the terrified wanderer Jitters found the scythe inside the mine. His accidental release of more savage worgen drew the deadly Dark Riders to Duskwood.

faq.answer: Roland's Doom lies east of the Rotting Orchard in southeastern Duskwood. The abandoned mine is overrun by vicious Nightbane worgen.

faq.q: Why are there worgen inside the mine?
faq.answer: The Nightbane worgen occupy the mine after the Scythe of Elune was lost there. Powerful beasts including Nefaru and Gutspill make their lair in its shafts.

faq.q: Who was Velinde Starsong and why is she connected to this place?
faq.answer: Velinde Starsong was a night elven priestess of Elune who wielded the Scythe of Elune against demons in Felwood. Her journey brought her across the sea to Duskwood, where she died inside Roland's Doom and left the scythe behind.

faq.q: How does Jitters fit into the story of Roland's Doom?
faq.answer: Jitters entered Roland's Doom and found the buried Scythe of Elune. His meddling unintentionally released more worgen into Duskwood and drew the Dark Riders to the region, bringing greater peril to the forest.

angles.text: For night elves, the search for the missing priestess Velinde Starsong and the Scythe of Elune makes Roland's Doom a place to reflect on the fate of their kin.
As a miner, you know Roland's Doom is no place to work a pick. Bloodthirsty worgen stalk its tunnels.
